hook.name: RawbinHookRWA
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for RWA token launches on Rawbin/Robinhood Chain. Restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the factory. Applies a linearly decaying anti-snipe fee (up to 90%) during the first 30 blocks after launch via afterSwapReturnsDelta, donating collected fees back to the pool rather than to the platform.
